name: Dozer
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the retrieved Dozer checkout, Sparkle is configured with an HTTPS appcast URL and a SUPublicEDKey, and the preferences controller exposes SUUpdater's automatic-check setting. The checked-in appcast has one 4.0.0 item dated 20 August 2019 and includes a sparkle:edSignature, so the feed snapshot is stale relative to the checkout's 4.2.0 bundle metadata.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification; the checked-in feed may be stale or archival, and published bundle/signature validity plus Sparkle's framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | Dozer (menu-bar icon hider) | https://github.com/Mortennn/Dozer | Sparkle, legacy 1.x `SUUpdater` API | Y | Y, user-toggleable (`GeneralVC` checkbox bound directly to `SUUpdater.shared().automaticallyChecksForUpdates`) | Y (once user approves) | https (`SUFeedURL`=`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mortennn/Dozer/master/appcast.xml`) | Sparkle-EdDSA | signature (EdDSA) | pinned-in-binary (`SUPublicEDKey` in Info.plist) | Dozer/Other/Info.plist:33-36 (`SUFeedURL`, `SUPublicEDKey`=`97gvwr+B10rf6Exnj8yPuAXrYSu9yKikViJkYkvPMHY=`); Dozer/ViewControllers/GeneralVC.swift:39-73 (`SUUpdater.shared()!.automaticallyChecksForUpdates`); live fetch of the appcast on 2026-08-19 shows a single `<item>`, v4.0.0 (dated Aug 2019), with a valid `sparkle:edSignature` — key hygiene is fine but the feed itself appears stale/unmaintained (no releases posted since 2019 despite the GitHub repo still existing) |
